MyTransferView.description: One owner-transfer request addressed to the caller.

expiresAt.description: When the confirmation window closes, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

requestedAt.description: When the request was made, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

status.description: The request's state. Only pending requests can be confirmed or declined.

tenant.description: The organization whose ownership the request is about, by its name.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

get.description: Lists every pending owner-transfer request addressed to the caller, across every organization. The caller's own identity is the whole credential: no tenant context and no organization permission is asked. Expired requests are settled as expired before the read.

schema.description: Every pending owner-transfer request addressed to the caller.

requests.description: The caller's pending requests, ordered by request time.

get.summary: List the caller's pending ownership-transfer requests

get.description: Reads one request addressed to the caller in whatever state it is, so a deep link can show a request that was already confirmed, declined, cancelled or expired. A request that does not exist and one addressed to another account are answered alike with a bare 404.

schema.description: One owner-transfer request addressed to the caller, in whatever state it is.

request.description: The request, with the organization's name and its state.

404.description: No such request is addressed to the caller

get.summary: Read one ownership-transfer request addressed to the caller

post.description: Confirms one pending request addressed to the caller and writes the transfer. The request is re-read under the organization's lock; the requester must still be the owner and the caller must still be an active member, or the request is answered 409. The previous owner stays an active member and keeps every binding it held. A mandatory audit row lands before the write; if it cannot, nothing is written and the request is answered 503. An unverified self-registration is answered 403 contact-required.

403.description: The caller has not proved an email address (contact-required)

404.description: No such request is addressed to the caller

409.description: The request is no longer pending or has expired, the requester no longer owns the organization, the organization was deleted, or the caller is no longer an active member

post.summary: Confirm an ownership-transfer request addressed to the caller

post.description: Declines one pending request addressed to the caller. Ownership does not change. The caller's own identity is the whole credential; the action is harmless and carries no registration gate.

404.description: No such request is addressed to the caller

409.description: The request is no longer pending or has expired

post.summary: Decline an ownership-transfer request addressed to the caller
